out of memory: Check the container memory limit and the shard size. Rerun the shard alone; if it passes, split the shard or raise the limit.
network timeout: Check the artifact server health and the runner network route. Retry once, then page the artifact service owner.
authentication failure: Rotate or refresh the registry token in the CI credential store and rerun.
disk full: Clear the build cache on the runner and check the cleanup job. Move the workspace to the data volume if it is on the OS drive.
test failure: Reproduce the failing test locally on the same revision. Check recent commits touching the test or its fixtures.
